Hi all — quick summary from Redwood’s verification run and the proposed remedy: 

Verification steps completed:
- Pulled production traces for the indicated period and matched 03:37:20–04:05:11 UTC as the primary window.
- Confirmed increased 5xx rate from the serving tier and repeated timeouts in the request path (see redwood_trace_usw2_20280605.ndjson).
- Cross-checked your sample transaction IDs against our ingress logs; they failed with 504s at the same timestamps.

Preliminary eligibility conclusion:
- This incident meets the criteria for an availability SLA breach under section 4.2 (partial regional outage causing >10% error rate sustained >15m). We therefore consider the account eligible for a prorated credit.

Proposed compensation and operational remedy:
- Credit amount: prorated percentage for the impacted window = 6.2% of June’s consumption invoice (method: time-weighted availability).
- Credit split proposal: 70% applied as a refundable invoice credit; 30% applied as an account-level service credit (enhanced monitoring & extended retention for 30 days).
- Postmortem: Redwood will produce a standard RCA and a short remediation plan within 10 business days. We propose a joint SRE call to review traces and mitigation steps; available slots: Mon 09 Jun 11:00–12:00 PT or Tue 10 Jun 09:00–10:00 PT.

Please confirm acceptance of the proposed split and whether finance needs a different format for applying the credit. If you prefer a single invoice credit instead of the split, we can do that — I want to make sure the path meets your procurement needs.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Escalations Lead, Customer Success
Redwood Inference
